//: Story Phase 14 logbooks: the rules on the barricade (one per incident that taught them), the pocket edition's newer entries (in Garrick's legends: one or two of them VERIFIED now), the captain's journal. The bank's ledger is data/logs/phase14_bank.json.

brogath_rules.title: The Brogath Rules
brogath_rules.byline: <k>Written by</> Pete, on parchment, on the barricade. <k>Learned</> the hard way.

entries.title: Rule 1
entries.because: Jim laughed. The first eruption. 'Sorry. Little toot.'

entries.title: Rule 2
entries.rule: DO NOT REMIND BROGATH HE IS CARDBOARD. (UNLESS NECESSARY.)
entries.because: Bob told him. AGES EIGHT AND UP, on his back.

entries.title: Rule 3
entries.because: Gristle told him he'd been dead four hundred years.

entries.title: Rule 4
entries.rule: DO NOT INSULT BROGATH'S PRINT QUALITY.
entries.because: Bob said his face was smudged. (It is.)

entries.title: Rule 5
entries.because: Garrick sighed at a page of his own book.

entries.title: Rule 6
entries.because: Squawks spread his wings. Squawks now walks. Squawks hates it.

entries.title: Rule 7
entries.because: A shirt-tail, a label, a napkin, a page, a parrot, a flag. Underlined three times.

entries.title: Rule 8
entries.because: The Apology Eruption. The flutter from his own apology made it worse.

entries.title: Rule 9
entries.rule: IF BROGATH CALLS IT A TOOT, AGREE.
entries.because: It moved the table. It moved the SHIP. It was a toot. Agreed.

entries.title: Rule 10
entries.rule: ALL SASHES TUCKED IN. EVEN GRAND ONES.
entries.because: Garrick put his sash back on with a flourish.

entries.title: Rule 11
entries.rule: NO ONE MENTIONS THE GRAND WAFT TRIALS.
entries.because: Seven days. Seven events. A mountain range, a little to the left.

entries.title: Rule 12
entries.rule: COMPLIMENTS BY TURNS. NEVER TWO IN A ROW FOR THE SAME GRAND STENCHMASTER.
entries.because: Garrick sulks. Brogath notices Garrick sulking. Then Brogath goes pink.

entries.title: Rule 13
entries.rule: BROGATH NEVER GOES NEAR THE TREASURE ROOM.
entries.because: Brogath. Treasure. Sharkstorm. Beans. Flutter. All five.

entries.title: Rule 14
entries.because: He doesn't talk about the second time. Neither do we.

entries.title: Rule 15
entries.because: One oat. Three sacks. One in the Sharkstorm.

entries.title: Rule 16
entries.rule: BROGATH MUST NOT ATTEMPT COMPLICATED MACHINERY.
entries.because: The fine-tuning wheel. It came off in his hand.

entries.title: Rule 17
entries.because: The Bling Bling King bought advertising.

entries.title: Rule 18
entries.because: Seven of them. The Anger Waft. A BANK, on the DECK.

entries.title: Rule 19
entries.rule: BROGATH MAY ONLY BE CALLED AN IDIOT IF 'DISTINGUISHED' IS IMMEDIATELY INCLUDED.
entries.because: Ten minutes and forty-seven seconds.

entries.title: Rule 20
entries.because: UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCES SHOULD A GRAND STENCHMASTER UNDERGOING DISPERSAL BE PERMITTED ACCESS TO A SUIT OF ARMOR.

entries.title: Rule 21
entries.rule: ALL ADVERTISING SASHES ARE PROFESSIONAL. TRAINED. LICENSED. FOR CONTROLLED COMMERCIAL FLUTTER.
entries.because: Mandatory History Night. It shouldn't have worked. It worked.

entries.title: Brogath the Bashful (Returned)
entries.claim: Brogath the Bashful, Ancient Grand Stenchmaster, is aboard. In a cardboard cut-out from the Fan Mega-Pack, by way of the old cloud in the treasure room.
entries.evidence: Him. In the old quarters. Very politely.
entries.verified: Yes. For the first time, yes.
entries.note: Every legend Garrick ever told us, and the one that was true is the one that moved in. (Pete, in the margin: he's very nice, though.)

entries.title: The Second Treasure Catastrophe
entries.claim: Brogath lost a SECOND treasure: a sash caught on a nail, a cabin boy said 'flappy', he tripped, slipped on a doubloon, hit his head, apologised to a beam, sneezed, and blasted forty ships' worth of gold into the Great Sharkstorm of that age.
entries.source: The pocket edition, page 77 (he asked them not to write it down)
entries.evidence: Every ingredient is on this ship right now
entries.note: BROGATH. TREASURE. SHARKSTORM. BEANS. FLUTTER. That's why there's a sign at the foot of the hold stairs.

entries.title: The Grand Economy of Farts
entries.claim: Ten Gust Pieces to the Wind Crown. Twelve Wind Crowns to the Atmospheric Doubloon. The Grand Gust: priceless, not for sale. Backed by the Internal Atmospheric Reserves (the Bean Treasury: Brogath).
entries.source: The pocket edition; Brogath's own ledger (buried with him)
entries.evidence: A bakery, a cloth merchant, a rope merchant's bucket, an undertaker. They all gave him things to make him leave.
entries.note: It worked because people kept giving him things after he farted at them. That isn't an economy. It's a hostage situation with receipts.

entries.title: When Brogath Ceaseth to Be Bashful
entries.claim: The Wrath of a bashful man is the Wrath of all the years he did not have it. The Anger Waft: hot, peppery, red, and strong enough to put things where there weren't any.
entries.source: The pocket edition, page 90 (no pictures: they didn't dare)
entries.evidence: A bank. On the deck. With a vault, and a queue, and Gary.
entries.note: Never ask him seven questions about anything.

entries.title: The Grand Waft Trials
entries.claim: When there were two Grand Stenchmasters in one place, they held the Trials: seven days, seven events (the Long Waft, the Silent Waft, the Waft Over Water...). The last one moved a mountain range a little to the left.
entries.evidence: Garrick has written something on his cuff
entries.verified: No. Never. Not on this ship.
entries.note: Not held. Not going to be held. Rule eleven.

entries.title: On the Dispersal of a Cardboard Stenchmaster
entries.claim: Soak the card; spread the fragments; fan the essence for months. No powerful active Grand Stenchmaster fart near the fragments the whole time, or he comes back. In whatever's nearest: wood, stone, iron, STEEL.
entries.source: The pocket edition, the very last page
entries.note: STEEL BROGATH. Holds pressure like a boiler. Nobody mentions the armour. Months, with Garrick: zero chance. He stays.

entries.title: Brogath the Bashful
entries.where: The old quarters (never near the treasure room)
entries.notes: I was right. I was RIGHT. I have never wanted less to be right about anything.

variants.notes: Ancient Historical Consultant. His duty: to remain confident. He remembers almost no useful history. He is the safest he can be exactly where he is, and that's on my ship. I used to rob merchant vessels.

entries.title: The Treasure Room
entries.where: The hold, behind five signs and four planks
entries.notes: I opened it a crack. A plume got out. The plume went into a cut-out. The cut-out is now a member of my crew. The door stays SHUT.

entries.title: The Grand Stenchmaster's Grand Bank and Grand Trust
entries.where: The main deck, for one morning
entries.notes: Nineteen depositors. One teller (me). Gary. Grandmother Gustilda: 10+, ABSOLUTELY NOT. I tried to redeem twenty thousand tokens and my hand went through the vault. What are they for? Being wealthy.
